name: Sheet To Rows
description: Read a sheet as records keyed by its header row — an uploaded price list, a stock count, a list of employees — one object per row below the header. headerRow is 1 unless given.

data.assignments: [{"variable":"result","value":"{{= (() => { const ws = workbook.getWorksheet(sheet); if (!ws) return []; const plain = (v) => v && typeof v === 'object' ? ('result' in v ? v.result : Array.isArray(v.richText) ? v.richText.map((t) => t.text).join('') : 'text' in v ? v.text : v) : v; const hr = +headerRow || 1; const headers = []; ws.getRow(hr).eachCell({ includeEmpty: true }, (c, i) => { headers[i] = String(plain(c.value) ?? ('column' + i)).trim(); }); const out = []; ws.eachRow({ includeEmpty: false }, (row, n) => { if (n <= hr) return; const o = {}; let any = false; row.eachCell({ includeEmpty: false }, (c, i) => { if (headers[i]) { o[headers[i]] = plain(c.value); any = true; } }); if (any) out.push(o); }); return out; })() }}"}]
